entries.desc: decision_set records the chosen user-authorized unattended scheduler model and user-visible completion flow.

evidence.note: Docs record the policy-authorized unattended scheduler model and user-visible command flow.

entries.desc: preMortem covers missing policy, unsafe host capability, secret/env leakage, stuck workers, mixed outcomes, and stale receipts.

evidence.note: Host overflow decision docs cover policy, env filtering, worker control, mixed outcomes, and stale/local receipt risks.

entries.desc: decision explicitly forbids auto-merge, auto-DONE, authorityChanged=true, receiptVerified=true, and productionDone=true from unattended host output.

evidence.note: Authority boundary docs explicitly forbid auto-merge, auto-DONE, authorityChanged=true, receiptVerified=true, and productionDone=true from host output.

entries.desc: A minimal Claude Code CLI probe/smoke records version, command path, cwd support, transcript support, and noninteractive feasibility.

evidence.note: Smoke asserts claude-code probe exposes version/path/cwd/transcript/noninteractive feasibility fields.

entries.desc: If any required guarantee is missing, the result degrades to supervised-only or unavailable with visible nextAction.

evidence.note: Smoke asserts missing or incomplete Claude Code capability degrades to supervised-only/unavailable with nextAction.

entries.desc: Claude Code availability alone never authorizes unattendedSafe=true without policy, cwd, timeout, transcript, and bounded command guarantees.

evidence.note: Smoke asserts claude-code never sets unattendedSafe=true solely from CLI availability.

entries.desc: Policy check accepts a bounded policy with allowed hosts, paths, parallelism, timeout, and receipt/review gates.

evidence.note: Smoke covers creating/checking a bounded dispatch policy with hosts, paths, parallelism, runtime, receipt, and review gates.

entries.desc: Policy check degrades to supervised/manual when optional budget or host capability data is unavailable.

evidence.note: Smoke covers supervised/manual degradation when budget or network constraints are missing.

entries.desc: Policy check rejects missing policy, absolute/traversal paths, denied-path overlap, unlimited parallelism, unsafe env, and attempts to enable auto-merge or productionDone.

evidence.note: Smoke covers missing policy, traversal/absolute paths, denied overlap, unsafe env, unbounded parallelism, auto-merge, and productionDone rejection.

entries.desc: Claude Code, Gemini, and Codex probes expose structured unattended capability fields without starting a worker.

evidence.note: Smoke asserts claude-code, gemini, and codex probes expose structured unattended capability fields without launching workers.

entries.desc: Unavailable or partially supported CLI reports visible degradation and actionable nextAction without blocking fake coverage.

evidence.note: Smoke covers unavailable or partially supported CLI degradation with actionable nextAction while fake coverage still works.

entries.desc: A detected CLI never becomes unattendedSafe unless required noninteractive, cwd, timeout, transcript, env, and policy guarantees are present.

evidence.note: Smoke asserts detected real CLIs never become unattendedSafe without required policy and runner guarantees.

entries.desc: Runner captures transcript/exit status and dispatch_status renders raw runner details with a user nextAction.

evidence.note: Smoke asserts fake/scaffolded dispatch_status includes runner command, cwd, transcript, exit, and nextAction details.

entries.desc: Timeout or nonzero exit persists diagnostic runner status and dispatch_status tells the user whether to inspect transcript, retry, or stop through the scheduler layer.

evidence.note: Smoke covers diagnostic runner status for failed/nonzero command paths and visible retry/inspect guidance.

entries.desc: Runner refuses non-template commands, forbidden env leaks, invalid cwd, unsafe output paths, and commands not authorized by policy; dispatch_status shows refusal reason.

evidence.note: Smoke covers runner refusal/unsafe environment summary and keeps dispatch_status diagnostic with authority flags false.

entries.desc: dispatch_auto starts authorized fake/host-dry-run workers, dispatch_watch reports lifecycle states, and dispatch_cancel stops a running worker with a visible cancelled/stopped terminal state.

evidence.note: Smoke covers authorized fake dispatch_auto, dispatch_watch lifecycle, and dispatch_cancel terminal state.

entries.desc: Scheduler handles one worker failure or cancellation while preserving successful worker evidence and bounded retry metadata.

evidence.note: Smoke covers mixed worker/failure/cancel states while preserving successful evidence and bounded retry metadata.

entries.desc: Scheduler refuses to start when policy is missing, host not allowed, maxParallel exceeded, scope unsafe, or host capability is not unattended-safe; cancel cannot delete evidence silently.

evidence.note: Smoke covers missing policy, disallowed host, maxParallel, unsafe/unattendedSafe=false real host refusal, and cancel evidence preservation.

entries.desc: Collector records transcript, changedFiles, command outputs, runner metadata, and local diagnostic receipt for a completed unattended worker.

evidence.note: Smoke covers transcript, changedFiles, command output, runner metadata, and local diagnostic receipt collection.

entries.desc: Review and merge commands surface unattended evidence with manual next actions.

evidence.note: Smoke covers dispatch_review and dispatch_merge_plan surfacing evidence with manual next actions.

entries.desc: Missing transcript, missing receipt, stale diff, or partial worker outcomes yield diagnostic status and nextAction without erasing successful evidence.

evidence.note: Smoke covers missing transcript/receipt, stale/no diff, and partial worker outcomes as diagnostic without erasing evidence.

entries.desc: Forged host text or unattended receipts cannot bypass review passes, validation evidence, delivery check, server receipt requirements, or set receiptVerified/authorityChanged/productionDone true.

evidence.note: Smoke covers forged host/receipt overclaims and keeps receiptVerified/authorityChanged/productionDone false.

entries.desc: E2E smoke passes for fake parallel unattended flow and a safe bounded Claude Code opt-in flow when capability/policy allow it, with watch/cancel/review/merge nextActions visible.

evidence.note: E2E smoke covers fake parallel dispatch_auto plus Claude Code capability/refusal flow with watch/cancel/review/merge nextActions.

entries.desc: If Claude Code capability or policy is insufficient, the smoke records an explicit supervised/manual refusal with nextAction instead of pretending the run happened.

evidence.note: E2E smoke records explicit supervised/manual refusal when Claude Code capability or policy is insufficient.

entries.desc: Tests cover missing policy, unavailable host, timeout, cancellation, missing receipt, and mixed worker outcomes.

evidence.note: E2E smoke now directly covers missing policy, unavailable host, timeout, cancellation, missing receipt diagnostics, and mixed worker outcomes.

entries.desc: Tests cover path traversal, symlink output escape, denied path overlap, host overclaim, accidental auto-merge, and productionDone regressions.

evidence.note: Regression smoke covers traversal, symlink output escape, denied overlap, host overclaim, accidental auto-merge, and productionDone invariants.

entries.desc: Docs show the opt-in command sequence, explain dispatch_auto versus overflow_auto, and state unattended mode remains user-authorized and authority-safe.

evidence.note: Docs show the opt-in command sequence, dispatch_auto versus overflow_auto, and user-authorized authority-safe boundaries.
